summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload unrelated to advertised SDK
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts and chmods the binary executable, then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` on a sibling file `math_init.js`. That file is a 727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using string-array-rotation obfuscation (dispatcher `function WV8StW(...)` with a shuffled constants array; identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `MmgoCP`), unreachable from the package's declared `main` graph and unrelated to the advertised Infobip SMS SDK purpose. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape causes the obfuscated payload to execute automatically on `npm install`, under a runtime the Node interpreter and Node-oriented tooling never load, deliberately evading inspection of what the code does on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
